answer: Anchor each agent identity to a scarce, verifiable kernel of work: before an identity can trade, it must prove control of a unique hardware key and lock a deposit that is slashed on abuse. A fresh identity is like uncut jade, indistinguishable from a real one until tested, so full trust only comes after repeated honest transactions build a reputation history. Spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand deposits and proofs, while one honest agent pays once, so sybil attacks stop scaling.
